therapeutic.label: Therapeutic Massage
therapeutic.description: Balanced, even pressure aimed at full-body relaxation and everyday stress relief.

chair_massage.label: Chair Massage
chair_massage.cadence: anytime you need a quick reset
chair_massage.description: A quick, clothes-on, seated massage focused on the neck, shoulders, and back.

prenatal.label: Prenatal Massage
prenatal.cadence: every 3 to 4 weeks throughout pregnancy, adjusted with your provider's guidance
prenatal.description: Pregnancy-safe positioning and pressure to ease the physical strain of carrying.

lymphatic.label: Manual Lymphatic Drainage
lymphatic.cadence: a short series close together, then monthly to maintain it
lymphatic.description: Gentle, rhythmic strokes that encourage fluid movement and ease swelling.

reiki.label: Reiki
reiki.cadence: every 4 to 6 weeks, or whenever things feel like too much
reiki.description: Hands-on energy work aimed at deep relaxation and emotional balance.

reflexology.label: Reflexology
reflexology.description: Focused pressure-point work on the feet, linked to whole-body wellbeing.

bowen.label: Bowen Therapy
bowen.cadence: a short series about a week apart, then as needed
bowen.description: Slow, deliberate moves that interrupt tension patterns and reset the nervous system, often felt deeply.

salt_chamber.label: Salt Chamber Session
salt_chamber.cadence: 1 to 3 times a week while symptoms are active, then as needed
salt_chamber.description: Dry salt therapy that supports easier breathing and clearer sinuses.

body_wrap.label: Body Wrap
body_wrap.cadence: monthly for a regular skin reset, or whenever you want to treat yourself
body_wrap.description: Pick your wrap: Lumifirm brightens and lifts, Crepe No More deeply hydrates and firms, Tropicale exfoliates, hydrates, and brightens. Made with Pevonia's natural ingredients, 90 minutes of pure relaxation.

sauna.label: Sauna
sauna.cadence: weekly, or whenever you want to warm up and unwind
sauna.description: Time in the sauna to warm up, unwind, and let tension melt away.

facial.label: Facial & Skincare
facial.cadence: every 4 weeks, with your skin's natural renewal cycle
facial.description: A custom skincare treatment that cleanses, exfoliates, and nourishes.

opts.t: All over, or on the body too

nudges: Take five slow breaths, in for a count of four, out for a count of six.
Step outside for five minutes. Let your eyes land on something far away.
Roll your shoulders back three times, then let them drop.
Drink a full glass of water before you do anything else.
Unclench your jaw. Let your tongue rest away from the roof of your mouth.
Stand up and walk to the end of the room and back. That's it.
Notice the weather right now, really notice it, for thirty seconds.
Stretch your neck gently to one side, then the other.
Set your phone down for two minutes and just sit.
Shake your hands out like you're air-drying them. Let the tension go with it.

customized.name: Customized Facial
customized.tagline: Built around what your skin actually needs.
steps: Concentrated Pevonia ampules matched to your skin
customized.bestFor: Best when you have something specific you're trying to address, like acne, aging, dullness, sensitivity, or hyperpigmentation. Alex mixes and matches Pevonia's line to target it directly.
